modules.module_title: Perform preparatory work

pcs.pc_description: identify the customer requirement for the PLC control panel including the field equipment and size of control panel
examine the onsite location where control panel will be placed
prepare the dimension of the control panel based on requirement
identify the required layout for mounting of components on the mounting plate inside the control panel
examine the panel fabrication drawing and internal mounting layout drawings to ensure these are as per requirement and standards
identify PLC modules used in the control panel
provide instructions to the fabrication team to give cut-outs on the panel door for mounting of panel HMI and fitting of panel switches

modules.module_title: Gather and implement necessary instruction set

pcs.pc_description: verify that the printer prints the specified material(s) in the format as per acceptable standards including resolution, and there are no discontinuities, jagged edges or undesirable marks or protrusions on the surface
collect information related to pre-requisites for software installation on PC/laptops for programming
check the availability of the communication protocol, to be used for communication between programming software and PLC
get detailed information on communication program blocks used especially for communication between different components in the panel
acquire and collect information of normally open (NO) and normally closed (NC) contacts in field
gather detailed information about bit instructions, mathematical instructions and conversion instructions and compare instructions to be used in the program
identify the timer and counter logics blocks, along with move data blocks, as required in process logics
identify the requirement of special blocks like PID, high speed counters etc.

modules.module_title: Design and develop the program / logic / code for the PLC

pcs.pc_description: discuss and collect information from customer regarding the equipment and instruments used in the plant
prepare input-output (IO) list and other PLC module from the inputs given by customer and provide instructions to the control panel makers to incorporate accordingly in the panel
communicate problem effectively in order to secure customer’s confidence
ensure customer satisfaction and positive feedback
record minimum customer complaints post service
avoid occurrence of repetitive problems post service
prepare optimum route plan to complete daily target visits

modules.module_title: Download / transfer the PLC program in PC-based software simulators

pcs.pc_description: download the compilation error-free program and transfer it to the computer based internal software simulator for further checks
activate the respective inputs in software simulator to check the automation logic and thereby identify any error
modify and edit the logical error, data address overlap and wrong IO address access to maximise program stability

modules.module_title: Test the program using hardware simulators

pcs.pc_description: download the modified software simulated logic into the PLC hardware available in office test bench
connect actual DI, DO, AI and AO modules to check the hardware loading on PLC
connect hardware toggle switches to test program reaction via virtual field inputs
connect hardware LED/lLamps to check output generated from PLC program
connect hardware analog simulators to check analog behaviour of PLC program

modules.module_title: Develop the error handling program for the PLC and test it

pcs.pc_description: ensure use of appropriate programming logics to avoid non functionality of CPU due to hardware errors
identify and examine hardware related error which may occur during testing of PLC program
execute these error handling programs by physically creating faults like supply failure, communication break, IO channel error, module failure etc.
generate outputs from error handling PLC program for error monitoring on HMI devices like display panels or SCADA systems
ensure completion of factory acceptance test (FAT) and send report to customer

modules.module_title: Test working of machine and the process plant

pcs.pc_description: prepare a flow chart for troubleshooting any machine/plant

take a program backup before and after troubleshooting
replace the module/equipment if it is found faulty and provide the module replacement to the customer according to PLC

modules.module_title: Work as per the organisational team environment

pcs.pc_description: identify team objectives and goals, team members by name, their role and responsibilities, greet them appropriately and respond to their greetings
comply with organisation’s policies and procedures for working with team members within and outside the organisation—especially related to privacy, confidentiality and security
work as per the environment to build trust and mutual respect
participate in decision making by providing facts and figures, give / accept constructive suggestions, take initiatives to help team members arrive at workable decisions and meet the goals
accept decisions professionally and support even if they do not match suggestions and personal views

modules.module_title: Communicate effectively

pcs.pc_description: communicate professionally as per organisation's protocols, using appropriate mode of communication—verbal, written, mail, phone or text—and clearly articulate the message to ensure that the receiver understands the message
listen to team members attentively, respond promptly, seek / provide clarifications if required
share important information with the team timely and refrain from overloading them with unnecessary and unsolicited information

modules.module_title: Co-operate with team members and superiors

pcs.pc_description: perform own role, receive inputs from others and make adjustments within permissible rules as per requirement, to produce output in time for other team members to follow

help team members to perform their role effectively and provide any clarifications/support they need, including tools /equipment / common resources as well as resolve any contentious issues amicably, involving the team lead or the supervisor if needed
let team members know in good time if commitments cannot be carried out, explaining the reasons, and provide alternate solutions, if any; let the team lead know about this

act in the interest of the team and the organisation, take initiative to correct the wrong, seek help or escalate if needed to ensure that things do not ‘fall through the gap’ and team goals are achieved

modules.module_title: Respect customs / preferences and gender / ability differences

pcs.pc_description: follow organisation’s policies and statutory guidelines w.r.t seeking information about others' customs / preferences, making references or comments on social customs / preferences, and refrain from hurting sentiments
accommodate team members’ preferences to the extent feasible, and in case they come in the way of fulfilling team goals, discuss with the supervisor/ team leader
ensure personal behaviour, conduct and communication styles, taking gender and disability of the person into consideration
list the different types of disabilities with their respective issues and ways to help them overcome challenges
use inclusive language, verbal as well as non- verbal, irrespective of the disability and the gender of the person
ensure equal treatment for all clients, colleagues and co-workers while respecting their personal space

modules.module_title: Adhere to standard safety procedures of the company

pcs.pc_description: comply with general safety procedures and those for handling an equipment, hazardous material or tool, followed in the company
remove finger rings or any other metal objects likely to interfere with the work before working on the unit
use of safety materials such as goggles, gloves, ear plugs, caps, ESD pins, covers, shoes, etc.
escalate the issue about hazardous materials or things found in the premises or any breach of safety procedure in the company
ensure zero accidents at work
avoid damage of components due to negligence in ESD procedures or any other loss due to safety negligence

modules.module_title: Maintain good health and posture

participate in company organised health sessions such as yoga, physiotherapy or games
handle heavy and hazardous materials with care, while maintaining appropriate posture, using suitable tools and handling equipment such as trolleys, jacks and ladders

adapt product / service to meet success criteria
understand accountability for timely completion of tasks
manage to express emotions in appropriate ways at workplace and understand the cause for the emotions

pcs.pc_description: analyse the problem accurately and communicate different possible solutions to the problem
manage to estimate the cause of the problem and validate

carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines and equipment
